1//! Inspired by pdf.js, we use a custom binary format to optionally embed
2//! the required cmaps in a space-efficient manner. However, we don't use
3//! their format description but have a custom one. For more information,
4//! see <https://github.com/LaurenzV/cmap-resources/tree/hayro>.
5
6pub(crate) mod embedded;
7pub(crate) mod huffman;
8pub(crate) mod reader;

22const BCMAP_MAGIC: &[u8] = b"bcmap";
23const BCMAP_VERSION: u8 = 0x01;
24const BCMAP_FILE_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 10;
25const SEG_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 5;
26
27const SEGMENT_RANGE_1B: u8 = 0x01;
28const SEGMENT_SINGLE_1B: u8 = 0x02;
29const SEGMENT_RANGE_2B: u8 = 0x03;
30const SEGMENT_SINGLE_2B: u8 = 0x04;
31const SEGMENT_RANGE_3B: u8 = 0x05;
32const SEGMENT_SINGLE_3B: u8 = 0x06;
33const SEGMENT_RANGE_4B: u8 = 0x07;
34const SEGMENT_SINGLE_4B: u8 = 0x08;
35const SEGMENT_USECMAP: u8 = 0x09;
36const SEGMENT_NOTDEF: u8 = 0x0A;
37const SEGMENT_WMODE: u8 = 0x0B;
38const SEGMENT_CODESPACE: u8 = 0x0C;
39const SEGMENT_NAME: u8 = 0x0D;
40const SEGMENT_CID_SYSTEM_INFO: u8 = 0x0E;
41const SEGMENT_BF_RANGE_VARIABLE: u8 = 0x0F;
42const SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_VARIABLE: u8 = 0x10;
43const SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_1U: u8 = 0x11;
44const SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_2U: u8 = 0x12;
45const SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_3U: u8 = 0x13;
46const SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_4U: u8 = 0x14;
47const SEGMENT_BF_RANGE_1U: u8 = 0x15;
48const SEGMENT_BF_RANGE_2U: u8 = 0x16;
49
50pub(crate) fn parse<'a>(data: &[u8], get_cmap: impl Fn(CMapName<'_>) -> Option<&'a [u8]> + Clone + 'a, depth: u32) -> Option<CMap> {
51    // While in theory we can assume that all binary cmaps are valid, it can
52    // of course happen that an invalid one has been passed from outside, so
53    // we still need to do proper validation.
54
55    if data.get(..5)? != BCMAP_MAGIC || *data.get(5)? != BCMAP_VERSION {
56        return None;
57    }
58
59    let mut reader = Reader::new(data);
60    reader.read_bytes(6)?; // Skip magic + version.
61
62    let file_len = reader.read_u32()? as usize;
63
64    let delta_table = &BUNDLE.delta_table;
65    let count_table = &BUNDLE.count_table;
66
67    let mut cmap_name = None;
68    let mut character_collection = None;
69    let mut writing_mode = None;
70    let mut base: Option<Box<CMap>> = None;
71    let mut _codespace_ranges = Vec::new();
72    let mut cid_ranges = PartitionedRanges::new();
73    let mut notdef_ranges = PartitionedRanges::new();
74    let mut bf_entries = Vec::new();
75
76    // Start parsing all segments of the file.
77    let mut reader = Reader::new(data.get(BCMAP_FILE_HEADER_SIZE..file_len)?);
78
79    while !reader.at_end() {
80        let seg_type = reader.read_u8()?;
81        let seg_len = reader.read_u32()? as usize;
82
83        let payload = reader.read_bytes(seg_len.checked_sub(SEG_HEADER_SIZE)?)?;
84
85        match seg_type {
86            SEGMENT_NAME => {
87                cmap_name = Some(Vec::from(payload));
88            }
89            SEGMENT_CID_SYSTEM_INFO => {
90                // Format: Each string is 0-terminated.
91                let mut r = Reader::new(payload);
92                let registry = Vec::from(r.eat_until(|b| b == 0));
93                r.read_u8()?;
94
95                let ordering = Vec::from(r.eat_until(|b| b == 0));
96                r.read_u8()?;
97                let supplement = r.read_u16()? as i32;
98
99                character_collection = Some(CharacterCollection { family: CidFamily::from_registry_ordering(&registry, &ordering), supplement });
100            }
101            SEGMENT_USECMAP => {
102                let base_data = get_cmap(CMapName::from_bytes(payload))?;
103
104                // PdfCraft patch: a binary `usecmap` counts against the nesting limit as a text
105                // one does; passing the same depth let a self-referencing CMap recurse until the
106                // stack overflowed.
107                base = Some(Box::new(parse::parse_inner(base_data, get_cmap.clone(), depth + 1)?));
108            }
109            SEGMENT_WMODE => {
110                writing_mode = match payload.first()? {
111                    0 => Some(WritingMode::Horizontal),
112                    1 => Some(WritingMode::Vertical),
113                    _ => None,
114                };
115            }
116            SEGMENT_CODESPACE => {
117                parse_codespace(payload, &mut _codespace_ranges)?;
118            }
119            SEGMENT_NOTDEF => {
120                parse_notdef(payload, &mut notdef_ranges)?;
121            }
122            SEGMENT_RANGE_1B | SEGMENT_RANGE_2B | SEGMENT_RANGE_3B | SEGMENT_RANGE_4B => {
123                let bw = seg_type.div_ceil(2) as usize;
124                parse_cid_segment(payload, &mut cid_ranges, bw, delta_table, Some(count_table))?;
125            }
126            SEGMENT_SINGLE_1B | SEGMENT_SINGLE_2B | SEGMENT_SINGLE_3B | SEGMENT_SINGLE_4B => {
127                let bw = seg_type.div_ceil(2) as usize;
128                parse_cid_segment(payload, &mut cid_ranges, bw, delta_table, None)?;
129            }
130            SEGMENT_BF_RANGE_VARIABLE => {
131                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, Some(count_table), None)?;
132            }
133            SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_VARIABLE => {
134                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, None, None)?;
135            }
136            SEGMENT_BF_RANGE_1U => {
137                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, Some(count_table), Some(1))?;
138            }
139            SEGMENT_BF_RANGE_2U => {
140                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, Some(count_table), Some(2))?;
141            }
142            SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_1U => {
143                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, None, Some(1))?;
144            }
145            SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_2U => {
146                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, None, Some(2))?;
147            }
148            SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_3U => {
149                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, None, Some(3))?;
150            }
151            SEGMENT_BF_SINGLE_4U => {
152                parse_bf_segment(payload, &mut bf_entries, delta_table, None, Some(4))?;
153            }
154            _ => {
155                return None;
156            }
157        }
158    }
159
160    cid_ranges.sort();
161    notdef_ranges.sort();
162    bf_entries.sort_by(|a, b| a.range.start.cmp(&b.range.start));
163
164    Some(CMap {
165        metadata: Metadata { character_collection, name: cmap_name, writing_mode },
166        _codespace_ranges,
167        cid_ranges,
168        notdef_ranges,
169        bf_entries,
170        base,
171    })
172}
173
174fn parse_codespace(payload: &[u8], ranges: &mut Vec<CodespaceRange>) -> Option<()> {
175    let mut r = Reader::new(payload);
176    let n_ranges = r.read_u8()? as usize;
177
178    for _ in 0..n_ranges {
179        let bw = r.read_u8()? as usize;
180        let low = r.read_n_bytes(bw)?;
181        let high = r.read_n_bytes(bw)?;
182
183        ranges.push(CodespaceRange { number_bytes: bw as u8, low, high });
184    }
185
186    Some(())
187}
188
189fn parse_notdef(payload: &[u8], ranges: &mut PartitionedRanges) -> Option<()> {
190    let mut r = Reader::new(payload);
191    let bw = r.read_u8()? as usize;
192    let n_entries = r.read_u16()? as usize;
193
194    for _ in 0..n_entries {
195        let start = r.read_n_bytes(bw)?;
196        let end = r.read_n_bytes(bw)?;
197        let cid = r.read_u16()? as u32;
198
199        ranges.push(bw, CidRange { range: Range { start, end }, cid_start: cid });
200    }
201
202    Some(())
203}
204
205fn parse_cid_segment(
206    payload: &[u8],
207    ranges: &mut PartitionedRanges,
208    byte_width: usize,
209    delta_table: &HuffmanTable,
210    count_table: Option<&HuffmanTable>,
211) -> Option<()> {
212    let mut r = Reader::new(payload);
213    let n_entries = r.read_u16()? as usize;
214
215    if n_entries == 0 {
216        return Some(());
217    }
218
219    // There are two types of CID segments, all of which are stored in a columnar
220    // fastion in the file:
221    // For the first type, we have a simple mapping from a single code to a single
222    // CID. In this case, the data stream first contains all codes using delta-coding,
223    // encoded using huffman coding. This is followed by all CIDs, stored as
224    // u16 (either as a raw CID, or as `0` in case the CID is +1 the previous CID).
225    //
226    // For the second type, we have a range of consecutive codes, which map
227    // to a range of consecutive CIDs. In this case, we have an additional "count"
228    // column that stores how many codes are mapped consecutively. These are also
229    // encoded using huffman coding.
230
231    // Read deltas for the start code points.
232    let delta_len = r.read_u32()? as usize;
233    let delta_data = r.read_bytes(delta_len)?;
234
235    let mut delta_reader = Reader::new(delta_data);
236    let mut deltas = Vec::with_capacity(n_entries);
237
238    for _ in 0..n_entries {
239        deltas.push(delta_table.decode(&mut delta_reader)?);
240    }
241
242    // Read the counts for each consecutive code range.
243    let mut counts = Vec::new();
244    if let Some(ct) = count_table {
245        let count_len = r.read_u32()? as usize;
246        let count_data = r.read_bytes(count_len)?;
247
248        let mut count_reader = Reader::new(count_data);
249        counts.reserve(n_entries);
250        for _ in 0..n_entries {
251            counts.push(ct.decode(&mut count_reader)?);
252        }
253    }
254
255    // Read the CIDs and reconstruct the character codes that map to them.
256    let is_range = count_table.is_some();
257    let mut prev_end: Option<u32> = None;
258    let mut prev_cid: Option<u32> = None;
259    let mut prev_range_len: u32 = 0;
260
261    for i in 0..n_entries {
262        let raw_cid = r.read_u16()?;
263
264        // Note that start deltas and counts are encoded minus one, so we
265        // need to add one when reconstructing them.
266
267        // Reconstruct start code.
268        let start = if let Some(pe) = prev_end { pe + 1 + deltas[i] } else { deltas[i] };
269
270        // Reconstruct end code.
271        let end = if is_range { start + counts[i] + 1 } else { start };
272
273        // CID 0 means it's consecutive to the last seen CID, plus 1.
274        let cid = if raw_cid == 0 { if let Some(pc) = prev_cid { pc + prev_range_len + 1 } else { 0 } } else { raw_cid as u32 };
275
276        ranges.push(byte_width, CidRange { range: Range { start, end }, cid_start: cid });
277
278        prev_end = Some(end);
279        prev_cid = Some(cid);
280        prev_range_len = end - start;
281    }
282
283    Some(())
284}

286fn parse_bf_segment(
287    payload: &[u8],
288    entries: &mut Vec<BfRange>,
289    delta_table: &HuffmanTable,
290    count_table: Option<&HuffmanTable>,
291    fixed_units: Option<usize>,
292) -> Option<()> {
293    let mut r = Reader::new(payload);
294    let n_entries = r.read_u16()? as usize;
295
296    let delta_len = r.read_u32()? as usize;
297    let delta_data = r.read_bytes(delta_len)?;
298
299    let mut delta_reader = Reader::new(delta_data);
300    let mut deltas = Vec::with_capacity(n_entries);
301    for _ in 0..n_entries {
302        deltas.push(delta_table.decode(&mut delta_reader)?);
303    }
304
305    // Read counts for range segments.
306    let mut counts = Vec::new();
307    if let Some(ct) = count_table {
308        let count_len = r.read_u32()? as usize;
309        let count_data = r.read_bytes(count_len)?;
310
311        let mut count_reader = Reader::new(count_data);
312        counts.reserve(n_entries);
313        for _ in 0..n_entries {
314            counts.push(ct.decode(&mut count_reader)?);
315        }
316    }
317
318    let is_range = count_table.is_some();
319    let mut prev_end: Option<u32> = None;
320
321    for i in 0..n_entries {
322        // Fixed-width segments encode destinations without a length prefix.
323        let n_units = match fixed_units {
324            Some(nu) => nu,
325            None => r.read_u8()? as usize,
326        };
327        let mut dst_base = Vec::with_capacity(n_units);
328        for _ in 0..n_units {
329            dst_base.push(r.read_u16()?);
330        }
331
332        let start = if let Some(pe) = prev_end { pe + 1 + deltas[i] } else { deltas[i] };
333
334        let end = if is_range { start + counts[i] + 1 } else { start };
335
336        entries.push(BfRange {
337            range: Range { start, end },
338            dst_base,
339            // PdfCraft patch (4): a binary CMap doesn't record the length.
340            code_len: 0,
341        });
342
343        prev_end = Some(end);
344    }
345
346    Some(())
347}
